feature: Immutable project creation attribution and app-admin creation log

flows.name: Attributed project creation
steps: Create a project through a request or integration writer
Inspect the immutable project attribution fields
flows.expectedOutcome: The writer records trusted actor or integration evidence and the database rejects missing or mutable attribution

flows.name: App-admin creation audit
steps: Open the Project Creation Log from Company Settings
flows.expectedOutcome: The read-only table shows searchable actor, time, source, status, and correlation evidence without exposing raw audit JSON

flows.name: Historical gap preservation
steps: Read the retained creation event for project 1145
Compare the event to available actor and source evidence
flows.expectedOutcome: The deleted historical project remains visible as legacy_unknown and legacy_gap with no guessed human actor

checks: The shared table page remains visually quiet and read-only
Project, actor, created time, source, and attribution status remain visible on mobile
Historical dirty metadata is not rendered as raw serialized content
Current project links are interactive while retained deleted events are not linked

claims.description: Every future project writer supplies trusted request or integration correlation evidence and the database fails closed
App admins can inspect the scoped searchable creation ledger on desktop and mobile
Missing historical actor evidence remains an explicit legacy gap instead of being assigned to a human
